name: grandma-storage-helper
description: Single-file portable desktop app that organizes files, detects duplicates, and keeps storage tidy.
author: Grandma Storage Helper

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.build:dir: npm run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build && electron-builder --dir
